sites.functional_impact_measured: Ouabain resistance conferred (pump function preserved); anti-HA immunofluorescence on intact (non-permeabilized) cells confirmed extracellular surface display.
sites.rationale: Position 119 falls within the first extracellular loop (computed EXTRACELLULAR span 118–129), flanked by TM1 (96–117) and TM2 (130–150). The paper explicitly names residue 119 as the insertion site and L2 confirms by intact-cell immunofluorescence that the HA tag is accessible on the extracellular face. Python lookup confirms seq_dict[119]='A' (residue_before) and seq_dict[120]='A' (residue_after). The loop is 12 residues long, providing room for a short tag; the pipeline's ≥3-residue-from-TM constraint is noted as a downstream check. Full-length Na+/K+-ATPase alpha-1 subunit with HA epitope tag inserted at position 119, expressed in transfected mammalian cells. Construct conferred ouabain resistance (pump function preserved) and protein was detectable in the plasma membrane. Intact-cell immunofluorescence with anti-HA antibody confirmed the tag is extracellularly disposed.

sources.claim: Immunofluorescence analysis of permeabilized and intact cells using a monoclonal antibody specific for the HA epitope showed that double tags at positions 119 and 318 were located extracellularly, whereas single or double tags at positions 173, 815, 881, 987, and 1023 were cytoplasmically disposed. These results are consistent with an eight transmembrane domain arrangement for the alpha subunit.

literature_notes: Two extracellular surface sites are supported by the ledger, both from PMID 8916902 (L1/L2). L1 reports eight tolerated HA insertions (119, 173, 318, 815, 881, 953, 987, 1023) and seven function-abrogating ones (338, 797, 805, 868, 895, 910, 921). L2 then resolves topology by intact-cell vs. permeabilized immunofluorescence: only positions 119 and 318 are confirmed extracellular; positions 173, 815, 881, 987, and 1023 are cytoplasmic. Position 881 is in the computed EXTRACELLULAR span 874–919 but L2 explicitly shows it is cytoplasmically disposed — the experimental result overrides the computed topology, and 881 is placed in other_positions as intracellular. Position 953 is in TM (952–974) per topology and is not mentioned in L2's immunofluorescence analysis; it is tolerated for function but is not an extracellular surface site. Positions 797, 895, and 910 are in extracellular spans but abrogated function and are excluded from sites.
